name: @monorepo-template/server
description: CMS Go API server, wired into the pnpm/turbo workflow via npm scripts.

scripts.gen:api: go tool oapi-codegen -config oapi.admin.cfg.yaml ../../openapi/admin.yaml && go tool oapi-codegen -config oapi.site.cfg.yaml ../../openapi/site.yaml && redocly bundle ../../openapi/app/openapi.yaml -o .gen-bundle/app.yaml && go tool oapi-codegen -config oapi.app.cfg.yaml .gen-bundle/app.yaml && redocly bundle ../../openapi/h5/openapi.yaml -o .gen-bundle/h5.yaml && go tool oapi-codegen -config oapi.h5.cfg.yaml .gen-bundle/h5.yaml
